identity.name: DWH Field Visibility, Masking and Redaction

purpose: Define field-level output visibility and masking/redaction profiles over exact schema fields while preserving internal canonical values, identity and classification.

entities.name: DWH Field Visibility, Masking and Redaction

value.field_rule: Visibility policy targets exact schema/field identities.
value.mask_rule: Masking/redaction affects the exposed projection, not the canonical stored value.
value.profile_rule: Masking/transformation profile is explicit and versioned where semantics matter.
value.classification_rule: Masked output retains applicable classification/provenance semantics unless explicit declassification applies.
value.derived_rule: Derived fields inherit governance from contributing source fields according to explicit policy.
value.write_rule: Masked/display value is never written back as canonical source implicitly.
value.authority_rule: Seeing a masked field does not grant access to its unmasked value.
